statement: For a Boolean function f on the uniform cube and coordinate i, writing u_T and v_T for the Fourier coefficients of its two Boolean restrictions, w_T=(u_T^2+v_T^2)/2, p_T=u_T^2/(u_T^2+v_T^2), and q_T=(u_T-v_T)^2/[2(u_T^2+v_T^2)], one has Inf_i(f)=sum_T w_T q_T and Delta_i(f)=sum_T w_T[1+h_2(q_T)-h_2(p_T)]. Zero-weight indices are omitted; Delta_i=H(f)-[H(f_i^+)+H(f_i^-)]/2 and all entropies are in bits.
proof_or_counterexample: PROOF.md section 1: two exact entropy chain rules and the Walsh restriction coefficients.

statement: For even m>=2 define g_m(b)=(-1)^(sum_{r=1}^{m/2} b_{2r-1}b_{2r}) and F_m(b,z)=g_m(b)-2*1_{b=0,z=1} on the uniform (m+1)-bit cube. With t=2^(-m), every base coordinate j in [m] has Inf_j(F_m)=1/2+t and Delta_j(F_m)<=2-(m/2)t<4 Inf_j(F_m).
assumptions: The exception is precisely one point b=0,z=1
proof_or_counterexample: PROOF.md section 3b: exact spectra of both restrictions and Jensen for u^2 log_2 u on [1/2,3/2].

statement: Proposed unproved sufficient lemma: there is one finite K such that every nonconstant Boolean function f on every uniform cube has at least one relevant coordinate i satisfying Delta_i(f)<=K Inf_i(f).
assumptions: One K independent of the function and dimension
EXISTS coordinate; not FOR EVERY coordinate
proof_or_counterexample: Reduction proved in C002; family C003 gives a positive instance, while the independent w505 selector obstruction refutes the all-coordinate strengthening.

statement: For any fixed tau in (0,1), the universal suitable-coordinate inequality is equivalent to its restriction to Boolean functions with max_i Inf_i(f)<tau, allowing different constants. A constant K_0 on this restricted class gives K=max(K_0,2/tau) universally, since every Boolean coordinate satisfies 0<=Delta_i(f)<=2.
assumptions: The all-small-influence selection bound is assumed, not proved
proof_or_counterexample: PROOF.md section 4: 0<=h_2<=1 in C001 gives 0<=Delta<=2; a coordinate with influence >=tau has ratio <=2/tau. The reverse implication is restriction of scope.
remaining_gap: At tau=1/16 the existence of one finite K_0 for all functions with all influences <1/16 remains unproved. The special family has large base influences.
scope: Conditional localization; known prior small-influence direction, no novelty claim
